title: Odialer 1.0.1 — OTA Engine, Security & Stability Update
highlights: OTA ENGINE — Improved over-the-air update management with remote manifest fetching, version detection, and update availability checks.
SMART VERSION DETECTION — Checks installed application versions against the latest published release to identify available updates.
SECURE CONNECTIONS — Remote update configuration and release information are retrieved through HTTPS-only connections.
APK INTEGRITY — Supports SHA-256 checksum verification to validate downloaded APK files before installation.
SAFE DOWNLOAD MANAGEMENT — Improved APK download handling with progress tracking, temporary file management, and verification.
PACKAGE VALIDATION — Checks the application package identity to prevent incompatible update packages from being offered.
SECURITY ADVISORY ENGINE — Supports remotely published security information, security status updates, and security changelogs.
REMOTE SECURITY CONFIGURATION — Allows security update settings and advisory information to be managed independently from normal application updates.
UPDATE CACHING — Stores previously retrieved update information to improve reliability when the network is unavailable.
SMART CHECK INTERVALS — Supports configurable update-check intervals to reduce unnecessary network requests.
NETWORK HANDLING — Improved handling of connection failures, unavailable servers, and unsuccessful update requests.
RELEASE INFORMATION — Supports release titles, version information, highlights, changelogs, APK metadata, and download information.
INSTALLATION MANAGEMENT — Integrates Android package installation handling and unknown-source permission checks.
DEVICE INFORMATION — Collects device model information and storage telemetry for the application.
STABILITY IMPROVEMENTS — Improved reliability across OTA checking, remote configuration, and update management.
RECREATETM — Continuing development of a more reliable and secure update experience for Odialer.
changelog: Introduced the expanded Odialer OTA management architecture.
Added remote update manifest fetching through GitHub RAW hosting.
Implemented application package-name validation.
Added latest version name and version code detection.
Implemented update availability evaluation against the installed application version.
Added configurable minimum supported application version handling.
Introduced remote OTA settings support.
Added configurable update-check intervals.
Implemented cached update information using SharedPreferences.
Added offline fallback handling for previously cached update information.
Improved handling of network connectivity and remote server failures.
Added HTTPS-only URL validation for remote resources.
Implemented protection against relative-path directory traversal.
Integrated verified APK download management.
Added SHA-256 APK integrity verification support.
Added download progress reporting and verification callbacks.
Improved temporary APK download file handling.
Integrated Android PackageInstaller launch handling.
Added unknown-source installation permission detection.
Introduced an independent security advisory management system.
Added remote security status retrieval.
Added security advisory changelog support.
Implemented security information caching.
Added support for remote security update configuration.
Improved separation between application OTA updates and security advisories.
Expanded release metadata support, including release dates, titles, highlights, and download information.
Improved overall OTA management reliability and error handling.
Continued stability and usability improvements throughout the application.
